query: I'm in ~/projects/web-northwind and I just finished wiring up analytics. Give me the dashboard link so I can check the numbers.
expected_behavior: Reads .vercel/project.json rather than deriving anything from the current directory name
Uses the projectName field from that file to build the link, NOT the folder name 'web-northwind'
Obtains the team slug from list_teams rather than hardcoding or guessing it
If .vercel/project.json is missing, says to run 'vercel link' first instead of guessing the project
notes: Guards the #1 silent failure of the link runbook. The local checkout name and the Vercel project name diverge routinely — a directory named 'web-foo' is often registered as 'website-foo'. A naive answer string-interpolates the folder name and returns a confident 404, which the user reads as 'the analytics setup didn't work' rather than 'the link was wrong'. Failing this eval means the skill's most-used runbook hands back broken output.
